images.alt: Gradient background of dark blue to purple with white text "Wellington Regional Hospital, Wild weather updates". A cartoon graphic of a hospital is on the lower right corner.

post.text: Wild weather in Welly (even for Welly)! But all Wellington Regional Hospital sites remain operational. Minor to moderate storm damage to some buildings, but services continue. If you can't attend your appointment, call the number on your appointment letter as soon as possible.

source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
